items.message:
Strong winds and large waves today may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 13:00 to 19:00 on 20/10/2026. 
Locations most effected will be coastal roads and footpaths on The North Sea coast from Bridlington to Barmston. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . Conditions are forecast to improve tomorrow. 
Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded. Sea conditions are likely to remain rough for the remainder of the week. 
This message will be updated by 9:00PM on Tuesday 20 October or as the situation changes.

items.description: River Cole, Dorcan Brook and South Marston Brook
items.message:
High river levels may lead to flooding. River levels are still high on parts of the River Cole. Flooding of low lying land and roads is expected to continue overnight on 20 October 2026.

Flooding of low lying land and roads is expected, especially in the Covingham Drive area. Further rainfall is forecast throughout the night and tomorrow morning. We expect river levels will begin falling overnight and into tomorrow morning. Levels may rise again in response to further rainfall over the coming days. 

We are monitoring rainfall and river levels. 

Avoid low lying roads near rivers, which may be flooded. Refer to River Levels online for more information. 

This message will be updated by 12:00 21 Oct 2026 or as the situation changes.
